_about: Each region's walls, as decided. Every wall is cut into sections along the lines on it (cut_walls.py: where other walls meet it, the page's named lines in it, and their images on the wall's other pieces), each section named by the regions on its two sides; a region is coloured on the sections it lies beside (a piece in a face of the cell or in the splitting mirror from its inside only). A wall some section of which the region does not border (outside the face and mirror views) is partial. region_view.py --defs cuts the walls, exports these and records the partial walls; cell_atlas2.py lists the walls in the key's Boundaries column, partial ones marked.
